notes: Cash (modified cash) basis school district; governmental funds only (no enterprise funds; school nutrition is a governmental fund). Receipts/disbursements/transfers from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (printed pp 7-9 = trimmed pp 4-6). Beginning/ending cash are fund balances (cash plus county treasurer balances). Balance sheet uses the Statement of Activities and Net Position asset/net position section (p3); no liabilities printed. Detail: each fund's Budget and Actual schedule (pp 11-26) used as the more detailed schedule; the General Fund Components combining schedule (pp 7-8) and Nonmajor Funds combining schedule (pp 9-10) are not recorded in detail to avoid double counting. Hidden transfer: the General Fund Components reclassification column (p8) removes 1,040,000 from General Fund disbursement lines (Student support services 80,000; Operation and maintenance 145,000; Student transportation 250,000; State/Federal programs net 565,000) and treats it as the transfer to the Depreciation Fund (received 1,040,000 on p17). The budget-schedule General Fund lines are kept as printed with group-level contra lines and a -1,040,000 other financing item (all marked review); the printed General Fund expenditure total 28,600,058 = line items 28,520,058 - 1,040,000 contra + 80,000 transfer (8000 Transfers and other) + 1,040,000 hidden transfer. Budget-only lines (debt services 5000 budget 9,329,805; Federal programs header budget 774,005; 4530 other federal, budget 13,800; QCPU disbursements budget 3,965; Coop tuition budget 75,000) have no actual and are omitted. QCPU Fund disbursements are blank (no total recorded). Activities fund Enterprise activities line categorized as student activities. Read pages 1-26 of 26. Motor vehicle taxes 1,962,358 kept as printed on p4; the Special Building column's 7,865 is listed on that fund's own schedule (p21) as Interest and penalty on property taxes (report inconsistency, no effect on totals). Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p6), Total Governmental Funds column.

report_discrepancies.note: Special Building 7,865 is printed as Motor vehicle taxes on the governmental funds statement (p4) but as Interest and penalty on property taxes on the Special Building budget schedule (p21). Amounts agree; labels differ. Recorded as printed on each page.

Special Building 354,686 is printed as Other nonrevenue receipts on p4 but as Other local receipts on the Special Building budget schedule (p21). Amounts agree; labels differ. Recorded as printed on each page.
